research_notes: The experiment should preserve failures rather than overwrite them with retries, because failure frequency matters for cap validation.
Append-only probe IDs naturally preserve that history.
Retries should receive new probe IDs even at the same target class.
State/current can point to the latest result while aggregate evidence counts all classified samples.
This avoids survivorship bias from keeping only successful retries.
The current retry is distinct from the prior under-target 14m sample.
